---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure
labels: bug
---

## Behavior

Expected result, actual result, and reproduction steps.

## Environment

App commit/version, distro, compositor (Wayland/X11), GPU, Proton version, and
provider. Include only relevant details.

## Evidence

Redacted logs or screenshots. Do not attach session data, raw inventory, or memory
contents. Report security issues privately through the Security tab.
